label: Modeled cost of living
notes: Hand-authored monthly estimates for the non-rent categories (utilities, groceries, transport, healthcare, taxes, entertainment), blended from EIA state averages, BLS regional CPI, AAA fuel prices, and KFF. Housing is now a live HUD Fair Market Rent pull (see rent-hud-fmr-2026).

label: HUD Fair Market Rent
provider: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
notes: Two-bedroom Fair Market Rent for the metro area, fiscal year 2026.

label: Modeled crime rates
notes: Per-1,000-resident rates for Denver and Long Beach modeled from published city figures. No FBI data per project decision; hour-of-day and 12-month trend curves are illustrative.

label: Sacramento crime (2024)
notes: Summary and per-subcategory counts are full-year 2024 totals from the City of Sacramento's published police records dataset (not FBI). Bucketing follows UCR-style categories; aggravated-assault uses the city's discrete category (a NIBRS-style figure would be higher). Hour-of-day and 12-month trend curves are illustrative, so the record is tiered modeled.

label: NOAA climate normals
provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
notes: Average high/low temperature, annual precipitation, and days at or above 90°F are pulled live from NOAA's climate normals (CDO NORMAL_ANN product — the 1981–2010 normals vintage; the newer 1991–2020 set isn't served by this endpoint). The flood, wildfire, earthquake, and sea-level fields in each climate profile are hand-verified estimates, cross-checked against FEMA NFHL/NRI and USGS (modeled).

label: Modeled climate profile
notes: Fallback climate estimates, used only if the live NOAA normals pull is unavailable for a city. Hand-authored from NOAA normals, FEMA flood tiers, and USDA wildfire norms.

label: EPA AirNow
notes: Current air-quality observation for the city's reporting area — a point-in-time reading stamped with its local observation time, not a rolling average.

label: Community estimates
notes: Median rent brackets and weather summaries are estimates; testimonials are illustrative composites, not attributed quotes.

label: Sample listings
notes: Illustrative neighborhood listings used to populate the property grid; not live market inventory.

label: EPA National Walkability Index
provider: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency — Smart Location Database
notes: Population-weighted mean of the EPA National Walkability Index (NatWalkInd, 1–20 scale) across Census block groups within ~10 km of the city centroid, served live from EPA's GeoPlatform ArcGIS feature service (public domain / CC0). Mapped to a 0–100 score; the 25/50/75 category cuts are EPA's own walkability tier boundaries. Block-group geography vintage 2018.
